tests.name: CTA Copy del Botón de Contacto — Versión conversacional vs directa (Copywriting optimization)

hypothesis.text: Changing CTA button text from 'Contactar ahora' to '¿Hablamos? Agenda una llamada' will increase contact button click-through rate among users who reached final summary/calculation stage by at least ≥10% relative to control version, p-value ≤ 0.05

control_definition.description: Current production version as of Sprint 4 implementation date
control_definition.location_in_ui: Bottom of resumen calculation display section (after quote total shown)

variant_proposal_definition.description: Proposed new variant to A/B test against control

success_metrics_definition.statistical_test_method: Chi-square test for 2x2 contingency tables comparing click/no-click counts per group

success_metrics_definition.calculation_formula: Sum of quote_total parameter values (in USD) for contact_click events from variant users / Number of contact_click events from variant users
success_metrics_definition.success_condition: Higher average revenue per click AND higher total click count compared to control, both statistically significant at p≤0.05

experimentation_configuration.user_assignment_mechanism: User_id hash or localStorage cookie persistence per session
experimentation_configuration.sample_size_calculation_basis: Power analysis assuming effect size = 0.1 (Cohen's h), alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8

tracking_code_placement_required_in_file: frontend/components/Servicios.tsx (modify contact button rendering per assigned variant)

best_case_scenario_description.outcome_if_variant_wins_significantly: Statistical test results show p-value ≤0.05 AND lift ≥10% (preferably ≥20-30%), contact_click_count increases by 95+ clicks over control period
best_case_scenario_description.recommended_next_action: Consider rolling out variant to 100% of traffic permanently with confidence that new wording improves conversion metrics measurably without risking baseline performance degradation

worst_case_scenario_description.outcome_if_variant_underperforms_signifi: Statistically significant negative impact observed (p-value ≤0.05 AND contact_click_percentage_decrease ≥5%), variant performs worse than control despite more conversational framing
worst_case_scenario_description.recommended_next_action_if_worst_case_oc: Immediately revert to control version, document reasons for poor performance in notes section below for future iteration analysis

expected_outcomes_analysis.neutral_or_inconclusive_outcome: p-value >0.05 (insufficient evidence to reject null hypothesis) OR lift falls between -5% and +10% with confidence interval overlapping zero
expected_outcomes_analysis.recommended_action_if_neutral: Maintain current production version as no statistically significant improvement demonstrated; consider A/B test for different variable in subsequent iteration cycle

documentation_references_for_context.section_relevant_to_this_test: Work-Unit D — Test A/B Framework Preparation (A.1 Schema definition, B.2 Initial Tests registration table)

tests.name: Disclaimer Placement UX — Flotante/Sticky vs al final del resumen (Interface layout optimization)

hypothesis.text: Displaying disclaimer text in a floating/sticky sidebar panel during resumen calculation viewing will increase advanced flow completion rate through Step 5 → contact submission transition by at least ≥5% relative to control version, accounting for improved visibility without disrupting content consumption

control_definition.description: Current production disclaimer UI layout as of Sprint 4 implementation
control_definition.display_location_current_production: Bottom portion of resumen final quote display section (requires scroll down to read)
control_definition.readability_characteristics_current_ui: User must scroll through entire quote to find/discover disclaimer text → potential point of missed information for users focused on quote total

variant_proposal_definition.display_location_new_variant_concept: Side panel visible throughout resumen calculation stage, not blocking main quote content but ensuring constant visibility without requiring scroll interaction
variant_proposal_definition.visibility_behavior: Sticky during scroll: remains partially visible regardless of viewport position within resumen step

success_metrics_definition.calculation_formula_purpose: Secondary check confirming variant is not merely shifting abandon point from Step 4 → Resumen view but actually improving final conversion to contact_submit

experimentation_configuration_parameters.user_assignment_methodology_same_process: User_id hash or localStorage cookie based assignment with persistence

frontend_code_modifications_required_in_: Frontend/views/Main/Aplicaciones/Servicios/Avanzada/AvanzadaResumen.tsx (modify disclaimer render logic from bottom static positioning to sticky side panel)
Frontend/src/hooks/useAnalytics.ts (add variant detection and tracking event tagging for AB-002)

UI_components_to_create_if_not_exists.location_in_resumen_step: Right side / bottom-right floating panel overlay not blocking main quote readability area

expected_outcomes_scenarios_analysis.if_variant_wins_significantly_p_value_le: Statistically significant positive outcome confirmed: floating/sticky disclaimer improves user comprehension/visibility during calculation review → adopt variant as permanent production version
recommendations_if_variant_wins: Document rationale for future reference and potential application in similar UI elements requiring visibility without disruption of primary content flow

outcomes_scenarios: Negative impact detected (statistically significant decrease in Step 5→6 conversion rate)
Statistically inconclusive / no observable improvement in either direction (p-value > 0.05 or confidence intervals cross zero)
recommended_actions_if_negative_inconclu: Revert to control version immediately if negative impact confirmed statistically significant
Maintain current static bottom positioning if no improvement detected and UX team consensus says side panel approach adds visual complexity without clear value

potential_downsides_of_sticky_side_panel: May add visual clutter to clean resumen layout
Could distract users focused on processing quote totals rather than seeing disclaimer information
benefits_of_current_static_approach_that: Cleaner UI design with minimal distractions during calculation display stage
Lower cognitive load for users focused on reviewing quote details without scrolling through long-form content
